# IT Department

> IT Department is a Kosovo technology company in Prishtina that helps businesses build clearer digital systems: websites, software, AI agents, automation, IT support, infrastructure and cybersecurity.

## Core Facts

- Official website: https://itdks.tech/
- English home: https://itdks.tech/en
- German home: https://itdks.tech/de
- Brand name: IT Department
- Also known as: IT Department Kosovo, ITDKS, IT Department Prishtina
- Location: Prishtina, Kosovo
- Market: businesses in Kosovo and Albanian-speaking business markets
- Phone and WhatsApp: +38349573570
- Email: info@itdks.tech
- Languages: Albanian, English, German

## What IT Department Does

- Builds business websites that explain the offer clearly and convert visitors into leads.
- Builds software, internal systems and applications for business workflows.
- Builds AI agents for repetitive business work such as replies, support, reporting, document checks, reminders and task follow-up.
- Provides IT support, infrastructure setup, networks, backups and monitoring.
- Provides cybersecurity, audits and safer system structure.
- Provides branding, visual design, social media and digital marketing.
- Runs a website AI chat assistant for first-line sales and support questions, with human follow-up through WhatsApp, email, or Calendly when needed.
